premises.text: Lab-centric raw-milk testing is time-consuming, labor-intensive, error-prone, and typically only monthly, leaving farmers without real-time herd health information
premises.evidence_span: this lab-centric testing is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and often prone to human errors

premises.text: Mastitis is common, costly, hard to detect early, and spreads easily, so farms need to test often and early
premises.evidence_span: To stop it, you need to test often and test early

premises.text: A handheld optical milk analyzer with embedded ML captures chemical-free optical data and returns fat, protein, and somatic cell count in about ten seconds
premises.evidence_span: The hardware can capture the optical data from milk directly without any chemicals

premises.text: A portal/dashboard plus remote veterinary support gives herd- and cow-level continuous quality and health management
premises.evidence_span: a portal with customized data visual for milk quality and health management

premises.text: The reagent-free low-maintenance no-special-training approach scales from producers to co-ops and processors
premises.evidence_span: our technology is reagent-free, low-maintenance, and requires no special training

domains.name: Infrequent error-prone milk testing and mastitis

value.text: Bring lab testing to the field for continuous milk quality and earlier mastitis control that improves animal health and profitability
value.evidence_span: identifies mass status before it spreads among herd and cause major economic losses

secondary_value.text: Unlock milk data innovation across the dairy supply chain
secondary_value.evidence_span: By unlocking this critical data, we can power innovation across the entire supply chain
